scope: Local adversarial fake API only; not remote PostgREST/permissions verification
checks: Default plan sends one read and zero writes
Single-row update changes only two document values; all other content and metadata exact
Concurrent ordinary writer metadata prevents update; no retry
Stale full content, a different current bank, or absent recorded approval prevents writes
Uncertain mutation transport stops without retry
remaining: Need applied service credential, authenticated read-only plan and normal live public verification after a successful guarded write.
